headline: Fighting Flares in Mooring County as Weathered Expanse Grind Persists
war_summary: Fresh skirmishing has erupted in Mooring County over the past two hours, centered on fierce contests around The Wind Hills, though Warden forces retain nominal possession of all twelve strategic bases. In Weathered Expanse, active combat continues right up to the wire, maintaining a fractured sector of five Colonial redoubts, three Warden positions, and a ruined no-man's-land amid more than two thousand casualties over the past two hours. The furious operational churn across Palantine Berm has noticeably decelerated, producing three transitions in the latest two-hour stretch as Warden defenders steady their grip on all seven strongpoints. Across Nevish Line and Marban Hollow, the flurry of base exchanges has ceased for the moment; casualty rates in Marban Hollow have cooled dramatically following earlier bloodletting, leaving one strongpoint unclaimed. Farther along the line, Callahan's Passage and Stlican Shelf endure heavy, accelerating attrition with thousands fallen between them, even as defensive lines hold intact.
